## Highlights

TigerMarkView 0.8.1 is a packaging and release-infrastructure release. The
desktop viewer and the `tiger-mark` command behave exactly as in 0.8.0; the work
in this version is in how the app is built, verified, and published.

- The release workflow now builds the installer once and uses those exact bytes
  for every downstream check, so the file you download is the file that was
  validated.
- The Windows installer (GUI plus the `tiger-mark` CLI) is prepared for
  submission to the Windows Package Manager community repository as
  `ItTiger.TigerMarkView`. It is not yet live on `winget`; that follows the first
  accepted pull request.
- Release assets now include `SHA256SUMS.txt` and `release-artifacts.json` so the
  installer can be verified independently.

## Fixed

- The release pipeline no longer regenerates WinGet manifests after they are
  validated, closing a gap where the submitted manifests could describe a
  different installer than the one published.

## Prerequisites and known limitations

- Windows 10 or later, x64.
- .NET Desktop Runtime 10 and the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime must be
  installed. The installer checks for both and downloads neither.
- This build is unsigned. Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run; the
  published `SHA256SUMS.txt` lets you confirm the download.

## Install

Download and run `TigerMarkView-0.8.1-win-x64-setup.exe` from the assets below.
Per-user installation is the default and needs no elevation.
